(2) The doc never mentions the --sun/--core/--good/--bad/--info/--focus-ring families the product actually runs on: the primary CTA renders --sun #FFC700 (style.css:698, 813 '.primary{background:var(--sun)}', live computed .primary background rgb(255,199,0)), matching the yellow/gold branding in shots/baseline-home-390.png and manifest.json:8 theme_color #FFC700. (3) Dark mode §1: doc documents @media(prefers-color-scheme:dark)+:root[data-theme=dark] and features/ui/fiezel-dark-mode.js — NONE exist: zero matches for prefers-color-scheme or data-theme="dark" in style.css; features/ui/ contains no fiezel-dark-mode.js; index.html:18-20 comment 'm025-134: mode gelap dihapus' + <meta name=color-scheme content=light>; features/ui/fiezel-ui-manager.js:18 force-pins data-theme='light'; live dataTheme='light', window.fiezelDarkMode undefined. History/stack desync: starting the exam from its modal runs closeModal() (which calls FiezelBackNav.dismiss -> asynchronous history.go(-1)) and then immediately quizLoop() -> enterStage -> pushState. The async rewind lands AFTER the push, so the back-nav stack reports depth=1 (quiz layer) while the real history pointer sits on the base entry with no in-app entry beneath. Instrumented live: at '2-EXAM' snapshot stack=['stage:quiz:1'] depth=1, but ONE browser/Android back press mid-exam unloaded the app document entirely (URL -> about:blank) instead of closing the quiz. In the installed PWA this closes/exits the app mid-assessment. Because the document unloads, the quiz stage 'leave' hook never runs: abandonActiveSession/recordSkipExamFail never fire, so on relaunch levelTrust.exams={} — no failed attempt, no 24h cooldown. The back button is therefore also a free exam re-roll that bypasses the m025-177 anti-reroll rule, while the learner's in-exam progress silently vanishes. Same closeModal()->quiz pattern exists at app.js:4052 (levelEntryExam) and app.js:5735 (lessonSkipStart->startLessonSkipGate). app.js's own comment (app.js:3946-3951) names running dismiss() right before pushing a new entry as 'persis cara membuat riwayat dan tumpukan tidak sejajar' — startLevelExam does exactly that.

CRITICAL CHECK FAILED: assessments reveal correctness AND the correct answer after every question, mid-test, including exam mode. On tap, answer() adds classList 'correct'/'wrong' to the chosen option in ALL modes (app.js:6441 button.classList.add(ok?'correct':'wrong')) and fires answerFeedbackSignal (haptic+sound+'Benar!/Belum tepat' burst, app.js:2542-2546). The confidence popup then announces the verdict (app.js:1279). reveal() then highlights the correct option (app.js:6392 querySelectorAll('.option')[q.answerIndex].classList.add('correct')) and prints 'Jawaban yang paling tepat adalah <correct>' with full explanation, per-distractor breakdown and an AI-explain button (app.js:6395-6396). cfg.noHints only disables retry/hints (app.js:6486-6493), NOT the reveal. Verified live in exam mode: tap classes ['option correct','option','option','option'], feedback 'Jawaban yang paling tepat adalah students who collect plastic on a beach'. Because the exam draws from a finite per-level bank ('Soal diacak dari bank level A2 setiap percobaan') and retry costs only 24h (app.js:100-103,991), an examinee can farm the answer key across attempts — undermining the stated contract 'Jawab benar minimal 80% tanpa petunjuk' (app.js:126) and the verified-level trust chain. Same channel applies to placement (retake after 24h, app.js:6178).

Exiting an exam mid-test silently burns the attempt: 'Keluar' (and back gesture / bottom nav) triggers abandonActiveSession which records a FAIL (score 0/25, accuracy 0) plus 24h cooldown with weakSkill 'ujian ditinggalkan sebelum selesai' (app.js:1161, recordSkipExamFail app.js:987-993) — with NO confirmation dialog and NO message at exit time (quizExit handler just go('home'), app.js:6313; enterStage leave app.js:6559; no confirm() anywhere). Verified live: after tapping Keluar with 1 answer, state.levelTrust.exams.A2={attempts:1,passed:false,cooldownUntil:+24h} and the screen showed only the home view. The instructions modal never warns that exiting counts as a failed attempt — the user discovers the penalty only when reopening the panel ('Percobaan terakhir: 0/25 (0%) · yang menjatuhkan: ujian ditinggalkan sebelum selesai' + disabled 'Bisa diulang 24 jam lagi').

Tapping 'Keluar' mid-exam exits instantly with NO confirmation dialog and NO post-exit notice, yet silently burns the attempt: recordSkipExamFail is called (attempt logged as 0/25, weakSkill 'ujian ditinggalkan sebelum selesai') and a 24h cooldown starts. Same for the skip gate (skipGateCooldownUntil set silently). The user lands on Home with zero communication; the penalty is only discoverable later when re-opening the exam/gate ('Bisa diulang 23 jam lagi' / cooldown toast). Destructive action without confirmation + hidden consequence.

Reloading the page (or killing the PWA) mid-exam fully bypasses the attempt-burn penalty that 'Keluar' enforces. The interrupted activeSession is logged as abandoned/'interrupted' WITHOUT calling recordSkipExamFail or setting skipGateCooldownUntil, and there is no beforeunload handler. Empirically: B1 exam with 2 answers -> reload -> examB1 back to {attempts:0, cooldownUntil:0}; skip gate with 1 answer -> reload -> skipGateCooldownUntil:0. This is a free-reroll exploit (see a bad question bank, refresh, get a new draw) and makes enforcement dishonest: the honest user who taps Keluar is punished, the user who refreshes is not — contradicting the gate modal's own claim 'keluar di tengah jalan = percobaannya terpakai'.

The full explanation panel renders entirely below the fold with no auto-scroll and no visual cue that it exists. Measured across 10 real questions: #feedback top 923–1159px vs viewport height 844px, scrollY 0, visible pixels 0 on every correct-first-try reveal. The user sees only the verdict burst/badges on the options; 'Lanjut' in the fixed topbar is already enabled, so the whole explanation (Intinya, distractor notes, memory tip, AI-explain button) can be skipped without ever being seen. reveal() has no scrollIntoView, while the retry tutor turn does (app.js:~6386), so the inconsistency is one-line fixable.

load() awaits the three required bank fetches with NO timeout (app.js:2410). If a response stalls, the fetch never rejects, so the load().catch error path (app.js:7656) never fires. The static splash's 15s watchdog (index.html:125-134) then removes the splash, leaving a permanently BLANK main area: header and bottom nav render and look alive, but #app stays empty forever — no loading indicator, no error, no retry. Tapping nav during this state renders misleading fake-empty hubs: Vocabulary Hub claims '0 kata level A1' because V is still empty, presenting missing data as a content-less level.

Cold boot transfers 8.61 MB over 91 requests before the app settles (localhost). 6.03 MB of that is content JSON fetched EAGERLY at boot: reading-bank.json 1,896,680 B + listening-bank-v1.json 1,894,903 B (idle prefetch for placement) + vocabulary-master.json 1,157,695 B + grammar-templates.json 570,593 B + library-books-v1.json 331,753 B + 5 more banks — far more than the ~2.7 MB assumed. Under Slow 4G + 4x CPU: FCP 32.4 s, splash removed at 48.4 s, and at 52.8 s the home content area was STILL EMPTY (only header + bottom nav painted, #app children = 0). 64 separate script files (2.08 MB) load at boot.

After the splash leaves on a slow connection, the user faces a fully blank content stage — header and bottom nav only, no skeleton, no spinner, no progress message — for tens of seconds while the 6 MB content banks finish downloading (screenshot at T+52.8 s shows empty #app). features/ui/skeleton-helpers.js exists but nothing fills the home stage in this state. Blank-after-splash is the single strongest 'app feels broken/slow' signal.

Tapping the main CTA gives ZERO feedback on the page (no spinner, no disabled state, no aria-busy, no toast) while it silently opens a puter.com sign-in popup and awaits it with NO timeout. If the popup stays open unattended (or opens behind the window), the app hangs indefinitely looking dead: 0 options after 66s of polling; a direct await of resolveAdaptivePolicy() never resolved (killed at 630s). The button stays enabled — 5 rapid clicks queue silently with no feedback. Recovery only happens if the learner interacts with the popup (question appeared ~3s after manually closing it) or if a popup blocker nulls window.open (question in 3.2s). Learner test fails hard: 'I pressed start and nothing happened.'

Flame icon renders at 300x300px because no CSS width rule exists for .fz-i inside .fz-ritual-streak. Card balloons to 580px tall, streak text 'Runtun 2 hari — jaga nyalanya.' is clipped off the right edge, giant flame covers the plan. Same defect class as the previously-fixed 'Peta icons 300px' bug noted in a style.css comment.
